analysis.one_line_summary: Static promo ad showcasing a model with polished blowout waves holding the WavyTalk thermal brush under the headline 'Skip the Salon, Style in 10 MINUTES'.
analysis.full_description: A square static image ad designed with a light sky-blue background and subtle doodle illustrations (megaphone, camera, styling brush) in bright magenta line art. The upper center displays the WavyTalk brand logo and the bold headline 'Skip the Salon, Style in 10 MINUTES'. In the center frame, a young woman with styled dark wavy hair smiles gently at the camera while holding up the pink/rose-gold WavyTalk Blowout Boost thermal round brush. A purple scalloped sticker badge on the left reads '10 Mins'.

on_screen_text.text: Skip the Salon, Style in 10 MINUTES

scenes.visual: A light pastel blue gradient background featuring graphic doodles in magenta outlines. At the top, the WavyTalk logo sits above the bold text 'Skip the Salon, Style in 10 MINUTES'. In the center, a framed portrait shows a woman with voluminous dark wavy hair holding the pink WavyTalk thermal brush next to a purple '10 Mins' sticker badge.
scenes.action: Static image presentation showing the model holding the tool beside her styled hair.

narrative_beats: Headline positions the tool as an alternative to expensive, slow salon blowouts
Model visual demonstrates the smooth, voluminous hair result achieved
Badge highlights the quick 10-minute turnaround time
pain_points: Salon appointments take too much time and money
At-home blowout styling is often slow and complicated
objections_handled: Blowouts take too long to do alone at home

talent.hair_after: Voluminous, shiny dark brown waves with smooth blowout bounce

analysis.notes: Static ad creative for WavyTalk Lebanon focusing on the Blowout Boost thermal heated round brush, emphasizing speed (10 minutes) and salon-quality convenience.
